validation_obligations.description: Confirm that both named external states lie in the zero-charge sector G_v=+1 at every lattice vertex, or equivalently in the exact reduced physical Hilbert space.
Confirm that the reduced plaquette and electric operators reproduce the physical-sector algebra of B_p and X_l, including all link-to-incident-plaquette relations at the open boundary.
Confirm that glueball is the zero-based level-1 Hamiltonian eigenstate in the physical Gauss sector, without imposing an unspecified D4 or other discrete-symmetry eigenvalue.
Confirm that no vacuum-energy subtraction or state-dependent coefficient has been inserted into the constructed Hamiltonian.
